856-2921-5776-8347.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

437-4613-7014.easyPrerequisites:
Sphinx's Disciple doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
North Pole Patrol is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
437-4613-7014.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
437-4613-7014.description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple using North Pole Patrol's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using North Pole Patrol's ability by tapping it, untapping Sphinx's Disciple
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, drawing a card.
Repeat.

2099-5267-7924.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' second ability triggers, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

443-4279-5933--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-4279-5933--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1086-1339-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1086-1339-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

240-2079-5470-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2415-4446-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1981-2415-4446-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-3699-4359.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
3259-3699-4359.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2060-2499-2762-6792.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters, Mm'menon triggers twice due to Yarok, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron and Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3398-7389.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger.
3398-7389.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Iroh triggers, giving Hellkite Charger firebending 2 until end of turn.
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering its innate ability and each instance of firebending it has.
Resolve all firebending triggers, adding {R}{R} for each trigger.
Resolve the other Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3398-7389.notes: Each loop will add {R}{R} more than the previous loop.

1116-5686-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1116-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Sek'Kuar and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

339-677-6974-7175.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-677-6974-7175.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7159.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7153.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Bruiser enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

277-2893-3875-5455.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Tiller Engine.
When the basic land enters, Tiller Engine, Tireless Provisioner and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1946-5465-7070.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Nomads en-Kor.
The Nomads en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Nomads en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

3394-4050-5010-7028.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Weatherlight Compleated trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw Golgari Thug from your library.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
When the Spirit dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1987-4316-4423-6893.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and The Eternity Elevator by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and The Eternity Elevator.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

585-2585-3767-3918.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Grim Monolith's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

969-2615-6562.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
969-2615-6562.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

1563-2457-4365-4885.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

338-2060-3129-3490-3910.easyPrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
338-2060-3129-3490-3910.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
338-2060-3129-3490-3910.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting ten +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

57-2178-4242-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
57-2178-4242-5231.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi with haste.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Su-Chi token, adding {R}.
When the Su-Chi token dies, it and Feldon of the Third Path trigger.
Resolve the Feldon of the Third Path trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2247-2431-4243.notablePrerequisites: Teferi has at least six loyalty counters on it.
2247-2431-4243.description:
Activate Venser's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, exiling Deepglow Skate until your end step.
At the beginning of your end step, Venser triggers, returning Deepglow Skate to the battlefield from exile.
When Deepglow Skate enters the battlefield, it triggers, doubling the number of counters on Teferi.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

147-190-4735.description:
Cast Crafty Cutpurse by paying {3}{U}.
Crafty Cutpurse enters the battlefield, causing all tokens that would be created under an opponent's control this turn to be created under you control instead.
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, targeting any permanent.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, creating a copy of Fractured Identity, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Fractured Identity, exiling Dualcaster Mage and creating a copy of Dualcaster Mage for each opponent you have.
The Dualcaster Mage token(s) enter the battlefield, creating a copy of Fractured Identity targeting Dualcaster Mage, and any other instants and/or sorceries on the stack.
Repeat from step 6.
You may also have the additional triggers target permanents your opponent control to exile them and create token copies of them.

1409-3456.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Rapacious Dragon.
1409-3456.description:
Activate Rapacious Dragon by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Rapacious Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Rapacious Dragon trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing itself and Rapacious Dragon.
Activate the two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1526-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Circle of Dreams Druid does not have summoning sickness. You control at least four creatures.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Circle of Dreams Druid
1526-5200.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid
Repeat.
1526-5200.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

1193-2557-3209.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna targeting Parallel Lives, creating two token copies of Parallel Lives.
Cast Sprout Swarm, paying for Buyback to create eight 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.
Cast Sprout Swarm paying for Buyback, tapping five Saprolings with convoke.
Repeat step 3.

2548-3149.description: Cast Obliterate for {6}{R}{R}, destroying all lands, creatures, and artifacts your opponent control.

687-2034-4351.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
687-2034-4351.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hallowed Spiritkeeper, adding {C}{C}.
Hallowed Spiritkeeper dies, creating at least four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens that enter with vigilance counters on them.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Spirit token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing vigilance counters from three Spirit tokens, causing yourself to mill three cards and returned Hallowed Spiritkeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
